Background

Frozen visual encoders may provide different control-relevant information.

Question

Does replacing Wan VAE with raw DINO improve closed-loop success on this fixed development cohort?

Method

Encoder route changes; matched demonstrations, minibatches, common initialization, backbone and final checkpoint. Dimension-specific projections differ.

Decision rule

Registered: effect ≥5 pp, positive in at least two training seeds, paired bootstrap lower bound above zero.

Outcome & next step

The registered cohort criterion passes. Task and seed generalization remain unproven; removing adjust bottle removes the benefit.

Background

The original training corpus covers only the original tasks.

Question

Do frozen checkpoints transfer to additional tasks?

Method

Same fixed expert-feasible scenes and paired action-noise streams; no checkpoint retuning.

Decision rule

Development feasibility pilot; missing episodes never become failures. No confirmatory superiority threshold.

Outcome & next step

No broad advantage demonstrated. Learn the additional tasks before testing the representation claim at broader coverage.

The official checkpoint is a functional diagnostic only. Its native paper score has not been reproduced, so it is excluded from this comparison table. Resource interruptions and missing episodes remain visible. Fully rendered sets are shown only for complete tasks.

Decision rule

Audit requires consistent identities and hashes. Exploratory sensitivity cannot replace the registered primary test.

Outcome & next step

The cohort effect is verified; broad transfer, raw superiority over compact, a wider output head benefit and a noise-shift benefit are not established.

views.title: ex7-b · Can the expanded dataset support learning?
views.html:
REGISTERED · collection in progress at snapshot

Background

Near-zero downstream success can reflect inadequate task coverage or faulty data.

Question

Can the frozen collector produce valid image/state/time trajectories on every preselected task?

Method

Fixed train/dev candidate seeds; same simulator and three-camera layout. No final-test data and no favorable-seed replacement.

Decision rule

At least one valid trajectory among the initial fixed candidates gates continuation. Native expert success, finite states and timestamp contracts must pass.

Outcome & next step

Expert trajectories are being collected. This does not measure learned-policy success or authorize full training; dataset audit and model-readiness gates follow.

views.title: Research plan · Evidence before attribution
views.html:
DRAFT · new scientific comparisons are not yet registered

Background

Existing evidence is too narrow to establish a general representation advantage.

Question

Where, why and at what scale does DINO help control?

Method

First broaden learnability and reproduce the native official baseline. Then compare encoders, information-preserving interfaces and world-supervision factors.

Decision rule

Freeze data, seeds, budget, checkpoint selection, primary endpoint and power analysis before each launch.

Outcome & next step

Positive, null and negative results determine the next branch. No task subset will be selected after seeing final-test scores.

  1. Finish data feasibility and interrupted evaluation recovery.
  2. Pass multi-task learning gates and reproduce the official native baseline.
  3. Compare Raw DINO and Wan VAE on independent test scenes.
  4. Control the learned interface; separate current observation from future targets.
  5. Repeat the decisive contrast at larger data/model scales.

views.title: ex7-a draft · Information loss or larger interface?
views.html:
WAITING · not registered

Background

Raw and compact routes differ in both information and learned projections.

Question

Does compression remove information needed for control?

Method

Train-only low-rank projections lifted back to the original channel count; include fixed random subspaces and an information-preserving rotation. Match learned tensor shapes and initialization.

Decision rule

Pending registration and power/cost gates. Diagnose normalization, noise scale and gradient differences before interpretation.

Outcome & next step

If compact controls match raw, reject the claim that raw dimensions are necessary. A gap alone does not isolate semantics from optimization.

views.title: ex7-a draft · Observation or future prediction?
views.html:
WAITING · not registered

Background

The existing route changes both current conditioning and future targets.

Question

Which part improves actions?

Method

Cross current encoder {VAE, DINO} with future target {VAE, DINO}; add a genuine current-only policy and a separate no-world-loss control.

Decision rule

Current-only action outputs and gradients must be invariant to future ground truth; the existing zero-world-loss flag does not prove this.

Outcome & next step

Estimate the interaction directly. Do not infer an interaction from one significant and one nonsignificant result.

Images → current encoder → action policy
Future frames → future target encoder → auxiliary prediction

These are the two intended replacement points. The action network remains controlled. Adapting input/output projections is necessary when the latent shape changes.

Source: OpenWAM paper, Tables 4, 9 and 10; released model card. These are provenance facts, not scores in our comparison protocol. Wan upstream pretraining and downstream SFT are additional to the embodied pretraining compute.

Background

The present controlled study is substantially smaller and lacks the official video-generative initialization.

Question

Does a representation benefit persist when pretrained knowledge and model/data scale change?

Method

Use a staged data/model scale ladder with matched controls. Test retaining VAE future prediction while adding DINO observation features; separately test latent-space replacement.

Decision rule

Pending feasibility, fixed compute budgets and native baseline reproduction. Do not assume the original video weights remain valid after changing their latent space.

Outcome & next step

A benefit confined to a small model must be reported as such. Official-scale claims require official-scale evidence.

Current Raw DINO trainable parameters: 300,936,724; completed training steps: 20,000. Model name strings are not parameter counts. Official “5B” describes the video backbone, not the total system.

views.title: Candidate contribution · ReWAM / R²-WAM in OpenWAM
views.html:
WAITING · adaptation proposal, not a reproduction

Background

Existing work already studies DINO features, compression and representation integration.

Question

Can faithful adaptations preserve or improve OpenWAM control under matched budgets?

Method

Implement and verify each route separately against the original method description, then test a combination only if individual routes justify it.

Decision rule

Engineering integration requires usable code and reproduced behavior; a scientific contribution requires independent controlled evidence and a clear mechanism or boundary.

Outcome & next step

A working integration is useful engineering. A renamed combination alone does not establish methodological novelty.

ReWAM · R²-WAM · ReWAM official repository. At the literature check, ReWAM code was announced but not released. No adaptation result is claimed.
